title: Automatic collection, automatic upgrading and automatic shel
features:
🔧 Resource Incremental (Auto Farm / Upgrades / Summer Event / Teleport)

⚙️ Farm
• Auto Collect Scrap — scans and collects all scattered loot
• Auto Convert Cash — automatically converts to cash
• Auto Teleport Obby — teleports to and through Obby courses
• Infinite Jump — infinite double-jump to breeze through Obby
• Anti-AFK — prevents idle kick
• Copy Group Link — copies the game group link

📈 Upgrades
• Auto Shells Upgrade — auto loops shell upgrades
• Auto Cash Upgrade — auto loops cash upgrades
• Auto Rebirth Upgrade — auto loops rebirth upgrades
• Auto Diamond Upgrade 1 & 2 — auto loops diamond upgrades
• Auto UpgradeTree Upg1 ~ Upg26 — auto maxes all 26 upgrade tree nodes
• Trigger Rebirth Reset — one-click rebirth reset
• 🏖️ Sand Layer — Reset Sand Layer + Auto SandUpgrade 1/2/3

☀️ Summer Event
• Auto ShellsClick — auto clicks shells in summer event
• Auto SummerTier — auto triggers summer tier progression
• Auto SummerUpgradeTree Upg1 ~ Upg17 — auto maxes all 17 summer upgrade nodes

📍 Teleport
• Dynamic full-map scan for all Training Stations
• Separate categories: Strength / Speed / Brain / Other
• One-click teleport to any discovered station
• No hardcoded coordinates — scans the actual map in real-time
